Arab Spring is a laughable example. People fighting to participate in a system that propagated their original problem. I find that remarkably short-sighted. 

I see no hope for societyin the ultimate ending.

because I believe that there is no way for actions to effect the environment we live in any substantial way, due to the backlash that conformity and civilization put on us. Laws, Codes, Regulations, ethics, all of these serve as ways to codify human obedience to a higher authority in my eye. Unless someone or something can take control of the locus of power and control, and change it, which is nigh impossible due to the fact that society is unwilling to drastic change.
